title: SAO signs in and reaches the SAO Dashboard
preconditions: SAO account 990001 exists. The SAO password is given to you separately. You are signed out.
steps: 1. Open the HIUSA sign in page.
2. Type 990001 in School ID.
3. Type the SAO password in Password.
4. Select Sign in.
5. Look at the page that opens and at the left menu.
expected: You land on the SAO Dashboard (the address ends with /dashboard/super-admin). The left menu shows Dashboard, then the groups Governance, Reviews, Files, Updates and Setup and records, and Profile at the bottom. VERIFY: if a Change password screen appears first, set a new password and tell the demo owner, then continue.

title: Sign in with a wrong password is refused
preconditions: SAO account 990001 exists. You are signed out.
steps: 1. Open the HIUSA sign in page.
2. Type 990001 in School ID.
3. Type a wrong password in Password.
4. Select Sign in.
5. Read the message on the screen.
expected: You stay on the sign in page and a red message says the sign in failed. No Dashboard opens. Do this only once or twice: five wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes for everyone who shares it. VERIFY: the exact wording of the message.

title: The SAO menu shows the right groups and pages and nothing from other roles
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001.
steps: 1. Look at the left menu from top to bottom.
2. Select the group name Governance and read the items under it.
3. Select the group name Reviews and read the items under it.
4. Select the group name Files and read the items under it.
5. Select the group name Updates and read the items under it.
6. Select the group name Setup and records and read the items under it.
7. Look for any menu item named Finance, Events, Voting or Store.
expected: The menu reads: Dashboard; University users; Ask AI; Governance (Colleges, Student records, Applications, Organizations); Reviews (Compliance, Approvals, Venues, Grievances, Clearances); Files (Submitted files, Storage and limits); Updates (University announcements, Notifications); Setup and records (Academic years, School year records, Audit trail); Profile. Selecting a group opens its first page. The page you are on is highlighted. There is no Finance, Events, Voting or Store item.

title: On a phone the menu opens from the Open menu button
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. Use a phone or a browser window narrower than 768 pixels.
steps: 1. Look at the top left of the screen for the Open menu button and select it.
2. Select the group Reviews.
3. Select Grievances.
4. Read the page title.
5. Open the menu again and select Dashboard.
expected: The menu slides in over the page. Choosing Grievances opens the Grievances page with its title. Choosing Dashboard returns to the Dashboard. The page does not scroll sideways. VERIFY: the menu closes by itself after you choose a page.

title: Log out asks for confirmation and ends the session
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001.
steps: 1. Select your name button at the top right (Account menu).
2. Select Logout.
3. Read the Log Out box, then select Cancel.
4. Select Account menu and Logout again.
5. Select Log Out in the box.
6. Press the browser Back button.
expected: The box titled Log Out says "You will need to sign in again to access your dashboard." Cancel keeps you signed in. Log Out takes you to the sign in page. Pressing Back does not show SAO data; you are asked to sign in. VERIFY: what Back shows.

title: The SAO is sent home when it opens pages that belong to other roles
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001.
steps: 1. Click the address bar and replace the end of the address with /dashboard/admin, then press Enter.
2. Note which page opens.
3. Replace the address end with /dashboard/department-head/approvals and press Enter.
4. Replace the address end with /dashboard/finance/budget-allocation and press Enter.
5. Replace the address end with /dashboard/events/manage-events and press Enter.
expected: Every time the SAO is sent back to the SAO Dashboard. No page of another role is shown and no error page appears.

title: Old SAO addresses forward to the Compliance tabs
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001.
steps: 1. Replace the address end with /dashboard/super-admin/approvals and press Enter.
2. Note the page and the selected tab.
3. Replace the address end with /dashboard/super-admin/financial-reports and press Enter.
4. Replace the address end with /dashboard/super-admin/event-requirements and press Enter.
5. Note the page and the selected tab.
expected: The first two addresses open Reviews > Compliance with the Financial reports tab selected (address ends with ?tab=financial). The third opens Compliance with the Event requirements tab selected (?tab=events).

title: A visitor who is not signed in cannot open SAO pages
preconditions: You are signed out (log out first if needed).
steps: 1. Open the HIUSA address followed by /dashboard/super-admin.
2. Note which page opens.
3. Open the address followed by /dashboard/super-admin/colleges.
4. Note which page opens.
expected: Both addresses show the sign in page. No SAO data is visible.

title: Admin, Department Head and Student cannot open SAO pages
preconditions: Accounts: Admin 900001, Department Head 940001, Student 2100142. Passwords are given separately.
steps: 1. Sign in as Admin 900001.
2. Replace the address end with /dashboard/super-admin/colleges and press Enter, then note the page.
3. Log out. Sign in as Department Head 940001.
4. Replace the address end with /dashboard/super-admin/organizations and press Enter, then note the page.
5. Log out. Sign in as Student 2100142.
6. Replace the address end with /dashboard/super-admin/audit-logs and press Enter, then note the page.
expected: Each person is sent back to their own home page (Admin dashboard, Department Head dashboard, Student dashboard). None of them sees an SAO page or SAO data.

title: SAO manages university colleges and institutional unified organizations
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001.
steps: 1. Open Governance > Registrations and organizations and observe the Add unified organization button.
2. Open Governance > Colleges and look at the Add college button.
3. Count the college cards and open the actions menu on one college card.
4. Verify options to Manage Department Head, Upload logo, Archive college, and Delete college.
expected: SAO can create and manage Colleges, assign deans, and add unified university-wide organizations. Regular student organizations are submitted via public registration and endorsed by Department Heads.

title: The Dashboard Review inbox lists what waits for the SAO
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. At least one registration or compliance submission is waiting (a Department Head 940001 has registered an organization, see Academic years first: A semester must be active first (Setup and records > Academic years, Activate).).
steps: 1. Open Dashboard from the menu.
2. Find the card titled Review inbox.
3. Read each line and its number.
4. Select the line Registrations awaiting review.
5. Read the page that opens.
expected: Review inbox lists the queues that have work, for example Registrations awaiting review, Compliance submissions awaiting review, Financial reports to approve, Event files to approve and Venue bookings awaiting review, each with a count and a link. Registrations awaiting review opens Organizations > Registrations and organizations on the Pending review tab. VERIFY: whether a queue with zero items is hidden or shown as 0.

title: The University operations numbers and the Organization filter agree with the real data
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001.
steps: 1. Open Dashboard and find the card University operations.
2. Read the five numbers: Registered organizations, Active organizations, Inactive organizations, Financial reports to review, Unread Notifications.
3. Open Organizations > Agency overview and compare the Organizations and Pending reviews tiles.
4. Return to Dashboard and open the Organization filter at the top right.
5. Choose one organization from the list.
6. Read the numbers again, then choose All organizations.
expected: The numbers match the Agency overview. Filter options read "All organizations" and then "ACRONYM: Name" for each organization. After choosing one organization the numbers describe only that organization (Registered organizations shows 1). Choosing All organizations restores the totals.

title: The SAO actions panel and Recent notifications lead to the right pages
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001.
steps: 1. On the Dashboard find the panel SAO actions.
2. Select Registrations and organizations, read the page, then go back.
3. Do the same for Colleges and Department Heads, Compliance and financial reports, University announcements and Notifications.
4. Scroll to Recent notifications and read it.
5. Select View all.
expected: The six links open Registrations and organizations, Colleges, Compliance, University announcements and Notifications. Recent notifications shows titles and messages, or the sentence "No new notifications. Organization notices will appear here when they need your attention." View all opens the Notifications page.

title: The Agency overview page is retired (not part of the system)
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001.
steps: 1. Open the SAO menu and look for Agency overview.
2. Open the Dashboard and read its counters.
3. Select a counter.
expected: Not part of the system: there is no Agency overview page with the four tiles Pending reviews, Organizations, Colleges and Archived. The Dashboard counters open the matching tab of Organizations or the Colleges page.

title: Colleges grouped on the Agency overview (not part of the system)
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. A semester must be active first (Setup and records > Academic years, Activate). Department Head 940001 has registered a new organization that is still Pending review.
steps: 1. Open the SAO menu and look for Agency overview.
2. Open Governance > Colleges and read the college cards.
expected: Not part of the system: there is no Agency overview with colleges grouped and summarised by organization counts. The Colleges page lists each college as a card with its Department Head.

title: Each organization row offers actions in its row menu
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. One Pending, one Active organization with no administrator, and one Archived organization exist (use the registration journey to create them).
steps: 1. Open Organizations and open the row menu of an organization.
2. Read the menu items.
3. Find an Archived row and read its badge.
expected: The row menu offers Open, Edit, Add existing student, Add administrator, Manage user profiles, Archive and Delete (items that do not fit the status are left out). There is no Review button and no Provision administrator button on a row. Archived rows show the badge "Archived, read only".

title: The four tabs show counts and open on the right default
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001.
steps: 1. Open Organizations > Registrations and organizations.
2. Read the four tab names and the number in brackets on each.
3. Select each tab in turn.
4. Read one card: name, code, college, status badge, members and admins.
5. Look at the address bar after each tab.
expected: Tabs read Pending review (n), Active (n), Returned (n) and Archived (n). The page opens on the first tab that has items in the order Pending, Returned, Active, Archived. The address shows ?status=pending, active, returned or archived. Cards are grouped under a college heading. A card shows the name, "ACRONYM · College", a status badge, and "N members · N admins". Pending cards also show "Submitted <date>".

title: Search narrows the list and each tab has its own empty message
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001.
steps: 1. On the Active tab type PSITS in Search organizations.
2. Clear it and type the name of a college, for example Business.
3. Clear it and type zzzz.
4. Read the empty message, then clear the search.
5. Open a tab that has no items (Pending review, Returned or Archived) and read its message.
expected: The placeholder reads "Name, code, or college". After a short pause the list shows only matching organizations (name, code or college). Searching zzzz shows "No active student organizations match this view." with "Try a different search term." Empty tabs say: Pending "No organizations are waiting for review."; Returned "No organizations are returned to their Department Head."; Archived "No archived organizations." each with a short hint line.

title: The Review registration drawer is retired (not part of the system); the Applications page shows the application and its documents
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. A semester must be active first (Setup and records > Academic years, Activate). Department Head 940001 has registered an organization with all ten files.
steps: 1. Open Organizations and look for a Review button on a Pending review row.
2. Open Applications in the SAO menu and open an application that is With the SAO.
3. Read the page: the applicant, the requirements and the Decision area.
expected: Not part of the system: there is no Review registration drawer. Registrations no longer arrive as a filing by the Department Head; the SAO reviews an application on the Applications page (see SAO-115), where each requirement has its file and can be accepted, and the Decision area holds Approve, Return with comments and Reject application. The reason is that the application is now sent by a student and endorsed by the Department Head before it reaches the SAO.

title: Return without remarks is refused
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. A Pending registration exists.
steps: 1. Open Review on a pending organization.
2. Leave Remarks empty.
3. Select Return.
4. Read the message under the Remarks box.
5. Close the drawer and look at the organization.
expected: The message "Add remarks explaining what the Department Head needs to fix." appears under Remarks and nothing is saved. The organization is still in Pending review.

title: Return a registration with remarks and the Department Head sees it
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. A Pending registration from Department Head 940001 exists.
steps: 1. Open Review on the pending organization.
2. Type "Missing charter signature" in Remarks.
3. Select Return and read the green message.
4. Open the Returned tab and read the card.
5. Log out and sign in as Department Head 940001.
6. Open Organizations and find the row.
expected: The green message reads "<Organization name> returned to its Department Head." The drawer closes and the Pending count goes down by one. On the Returned tab the card shows "Returned with remarks" and your text. The Department Head sees the row as Returned with the SAO remarks and the button Edit and resubmit.

title: Approve an application: the organization is created and the founder becomes its administrator
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. A Pending registration exists.
steps: 1. Open Applications and open an application that is With the SAO.
2. Accept every requirement and select Approve. Read the green message.
3. Open Organizations and find the new organization.
expected: The message reads "Approved. The organization now exists." There is no Provision an administrator step: the applicant becomes the administrator of the new organization at once. The organization shows as Active with its administrator.

title: An application that was already decided cannot be decided again
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. Two browser windows. An application is waiting for the SAO.
steps: 1. In window A and window B, open the same application from the To review tab.
2. In window A select Accept all, then Approve.
3. In window B type some remarks and select Return with comments (or select Approve).
4. Read the red message in window B.
5. Look at the Approved tab in window B.
expected: Window B shows the red message "This application is not waiting for you. Refresh the list." and the panel refreshes to show Approved. The drawer stays open. The organization stays Active; the second decision is not applied.

title: Edit an active organization
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. Use an organization that is safe to change (not PSITS-CCS), for example one made in the registration journey.
steps: 1. Open the Active tab and find the organization card.
2. Select the actions menu (Organization actions) and choose Edit organization.
3. Change the Description and pick a new Organization color.
4. Select Save organization.
5. Read the green message and the card.
expected: The dialog Edit organization has Organization name, Organization code, Main organization, College (read only), Organization color, Organization logo (optional) and Description. After saving, "Organization updated." appears and the card shows the new description and colour stripe.

title: Edit organization refuses empty and duplicate values
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. At least two active organizations exist.
steps: 1. Open Edit organization on an active organization.
2. Clear Organization name and select Save organization.
3. Type the name back. Change Organization code to the code of another organization.
4. Select Save organization and read the red message.
5. Set Organization name to the exact name of another organization and save again.
6. Cancel and look at the card.
expected: An empty name is stopped by the browser ("Please fill out this field") and nothing is sent. A duplicate code or name shows a red message such as "The acronym has already been taken." or "The name has already been taken." and the dialog stays open. After Cancel the card is unchanged. VERIFY: exact wording of the duplicate messages.

title: Add an existing user to an organization and manage its user profiles
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. A user from the same college who belongs to another organization exists (if none, only the empty result can be tested).
steps: 1. On the Active tab open the actions menu of an organization and choose Add existing user.
2. Read the note under the organization name and type a School ID in Search existing users.
3. Choose the user, pick a Role in destination organization, and select Add user.
4. Open the actions menu again and choose Manage user profiles.
5. Search for a School ID. Select Delete profile on a throwaway profile only, then read the confirmation box and cancel.
expected: The note reads "College: <name>. Only eligible users from this college who are not already members are listed." With no match it says "No eligible users found in this college." Roles offered: Student, SBO Officer, Department Head, Admin. A successful add shows "User added to the organization." Manage user profiles lists "Name · School ID", "Organization · role · status" and "Primary profile" or "Additional profile". Delete profile asks you to type the School ID to confirm; a profile that cannot be removed shows a reason and its button is greyed. With no match: "No profiles found in the organizations you manage."

title: Archive an active organization
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. Use a throwaway organization (not PSITS-CCS), because its members cannot sign in while it is archived.
steps: 1. On the Active tab open the actions menu of the throwaway organization.
2. Choose Archive organization.
3. Read the dialog and type a short Reason (optional).
4. Select Archive organization.
5. Read the green message.
6. Open the Archived tab and read the note at the top.
expected: The dialog says "<Name> becomes read-only and its members can no longer sign in. You can restore it later." After confirming, "<Name> archived." appears. The organization leaves the Active tab and shows on the Archived tab with the note "Archived organizations are read-only. Restore to make changes." and the badge "Archived, read only".

title: An archived organization is read only everywhere until it is restored
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. An archived organization with an administrator exists.
steps: 1. On the Archived tab open the Actions menu of the row and read the choices.
2. Try to sign in as the organization administrator in another window.
3. Sign in as Department Head 940001 and look at the row on Organizations.
4. As SAO open the Actions menu of the row, select Restore organization and confirm Restore organization.
5. Read the green message and the Active tab.
6. Sign in as the organization administrator again.
expected: The Actions menu has only Open organization, Restore organization and Delete organization (no Review, Edit or Archive). The administrator cannot sign in and sees a clear message (VERIFY wording). The Department Head sees the row as Archived, Read only, with only View checklist. After restoring, "<Name> restored." appears, the organization is back on Active, and the administrator can sign in.

title: On a phone the organization lists turn into cards and nothing is cut off
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. Use a phone or a window narrower than 768 pixels.
steps: 1. Open Organizations > Agency overview.
2. Scroll to a college and read a row.
3. Open Registrations and organizations and open Review on a card.
4. Scroll the drawer to the bottom buttons.
5. Open Reviews > Compliance and read the Accreditation tab.
expected: Rows appear as readable cards, every button is large enough to tap, the Return and Approve buttons are reachable at the bottom of the drawer, and the page never scrolls sideways.

module: Organizations > Registrations and organizations > Open (Organization overview)
title: The overview page shows one organization at a glance
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. Use PSITS-CCS.
steps: 1. Open Organizations > Agency overview and select Open on PSITS-CCS.
2. Read the heading, status and the registration steps.
3. Scroll through Leadership, Members by role, Events, Approved budgets, Compliance and Pending approvals.
4. Select Open the review queue, then go back.
5. Select Open on a document in Latest documents.
6. Select View all documents and then Back to agency overview.
expected: The page shows the name, "ACRONYM · College", a status badge and steps Registered, SAO review, Administrator, First use. Leadership lists people with positions and status. Members by role shows Students, SBO officers, Admins and Total. Events shows Upcoming and Recent ("None." when empty). Approved budgets shows Allocated, Spent, Income, Remaining and "N approved budgets. Only approved budgets are counted." Compliance shows the accreditation badge and Documents awaiting review. Pending approvals says how many requests wait. Open the review queue opens Compliance, Review queue tab; View all documents opens the Track documents tab; a document opens in a new tab; with none: "No documents have been submitted."

module: Organizations > Registrations and organizations > Open (Organization overview)
title: An organization that does not exist shows an error with a way back
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001.
steps: 1. Replace the address end with /dashboard/super-admin/organizations/999999 and press Enter.
2. Read the message.
3. Select Back to agency overview.
expected: The page shows "Organization unavailable" with an error description and a Retry button. The link Back to agency overview returns to the Agency overview. VERIFY: description wording.

title: The college list, its search and the View organizations link
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001.
steps: 1. Open Organizations > Colleges.
2. Read one card: name, code, organization count, Department Head and buttons.
3. Type Computer in Search colleges (placeholder "College name or code").
4. Type zzzz and read the message.
5. Clear the search and select View organizations on one card.
expected: A fresh seed shows 5 colleges. Each card shows the name, the code, "N organization(s) · Active", the Department Head name with a status badge and email, and the buttons Manage, Assign Department Head (only when the head is not active), View organizations and Upload logo. A search with no match shows "No colleges found" and "No colleges match your search." View organizations opens the Active tab of Registrations and organizations with the college name already in the search box.

title: Assign a Department Head to a college without an active head by invitation link
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. Use the Engineering college. First open Manage on its head 940005 and choose Deactivate (never deactivate 940001).
steps: 1. On Governance > Colleges find a college with no active Department Head and select Invite Department Head.
2. Read the dialog title and description.
3. Choose the College and, if you want it emailed, fill Send it to.
4. Select Create link.
5. Select Copy link.
expected: The dialog is titled Invite Department Head and says "Make a link for the dean. They fill in their own name, email and password." The SAO does not type the dean's password. After Create link the dialog shows the link with a Copy link button; if an email was given it adds "We also emailed it to <email>." (or "The email could not be sent. Copy the link and send it yourself."). See SAO-120.

title: Invite Department Head needs a college (the typed-credentials form is not part of the system)
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. A college without an active head exists.
steps: 1. Open Invite Department Head and select Create link with the College empty.
2. Type abc in Send it to and select Create link.
expected: The only fields are College (required) and Send it to (optional email). A missing college and a bad email are refused with a message under the field and no link is made. There is no School ID, password or confirm password to check; the dean sets those from the link.

title: Edit a Department Head and send a password reset
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. Use the Business college head 940002 or another head you can change.
steps: 1. Select Manage on the card.
2. Check that Save changes is greyed out and the School ID cannot be edited.
3. Change the Last name and select Save changes.
4. Reopen Manage, clear First name and type abc in Email, then select Save changes.
5. Select Create reset link, then Create reset link again in the box.
6. Read the green message.
expected: The dialog is titled Manage Department Head. Save changes is greyed until something changes. A good change shows "Department Head details updated." and the card shows it. Empty or bad values show "Enter the first name." and "Enter a valid email address." A duplicate email is refused under the field. The reset box is titled Create reset link and then shows a Reset link ready box with the link once, ending with "Reset link created for <Name>." (no mail arrives on the public copy, so the link is only shown to you).

title: Deactivate and reactivate a Department Head
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. Use Department Head 940005 (Engineering). Do not use 940001.
steps: 1. Select Manage on the Engineering card and then Deactivate.
2. Read the box titled Deactivate Department Head and select Deactivate.
3. Read the green message and the badge on the card.
4. In another window try to sign in as 940005.
5. Select Manage again and check Create reset link.
6. Select Reactivate and confirm.
expected: The box says they can no longer sign in and any open session ends. The message reads "<Name> was deactivated and can no longer sign in." The badge turns Inactive, the Assign Department Head button appears, and Create reset link is greyed out. The sign in is refused. After Reactivate the message reads "<Name> was reactivated." and the head signs in again.

title: Upload a college logo
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001.
steps: 1. Select Upload logo on one college card and choose a PNG smaller than 2 MB.
2. Read the green message and the card.
3. Select Upload logo again and choose a PDF file.
4. Read the result.
5. Select Upload logo again and choose an image larger than 2 MB.
expected: A good image shows "Logo updated for <College>." and the logo appears on the card. A wrong file type or an image over 2 MB shows a red message and the old logo stays. VERIFY: the exact message.

title: The five Compliance tabs open and show their content
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001.
steps: 1. Open Reviews > Compliance.
2. Read the five tab names and the sub tabs under Organizations and Requirement settings.
3. Select each tab in turn.
4. After each tab read the address bar.
5. Look for a data error banner on every tab.
expected: Tabs read Organizations (sub tabs Organization accreditation, which opens first, and Review submissions, with a number in brackets when submissions wait), Renewal, Event reviews, Semestral and financial report, Requirement settings. The address ends with ?tab=accreditation, review, renewal, event-reviews, financial or requirements. Each tab shows its own content and no data-load error banner (Requirement settings may show an amber guidance note, not a red error, reading "Every requirement needs a sample format. Edit the ones marked “Sample format required” to attach a file or link." until each requirement has one).

title: Accreditation tab ranks organizations by what needs attention
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. A semester must be active first (Setup and records > Academic years, Activate).
steps: 1. Open the Accreditation tab.
2. Read the card title and the academic year line.
3. Read the columns for the first rows.
4. Find a row whose Next action says Review N submission(s) and select it.
5. Read the Review queue that opens.
expected: The card is "Organization accreditation" with "Academic year 2026-2027". Columns are Organization, Accreditation (badge Accredited, Pending review, Incomplete or Returned plus progress steps), Requirements met (for example 3/11), Overdue (red when above 0) and Next action (Review N submissions, Awaiting submission, Waiting on the organization, All caught up, or No active requirements). Organizations with overdue items come first. The button opens the Review queue filtered to that organization with Awaiting review selected. With no data the empty text is "No organizations to track yet".

title: Add a requirement and see the checks on the form
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. A semester must be active first (Setup and records > Academic years, Activate).
steps: 1. Open the Requirements tab and select New requirement.
2. Select Add requirement with the form empty (clear the Academic year first if it is prefilled).
3. Read the messages.
4. Fill Name (for example QA Test Report), Deadline (a future date) and Academic year.
5. Select Add requirement.
6. Read the green message and find the row.
7. Sign in as Admin 900001 and open Records > Compliance.
expected: The empty form shows "Choose the academic year this requirement applies to.", "Set the deadline for organizations." and "Enter a name for this requirement." and the cursor goes to the first one. A good form shows "Requirement added. Every active organization has been notified." and the row appears in the Requirement catalog (columns Requirement, Academic year, Deadline, Description). Admin 900001 sees a notification "New compliance requirement" and the new requirement in Compliance.

title: Edit, switch off and delete a requirement
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001. Use the QA Test Report requirement from the previous case.
steps: 1. On the Requirements tab select Edit on the row, change the Name and select Save changes.
2. Switch the toggle named "<name> active" off and read the box.
3. Select Mark inactive and read the message.
4. Switch it on again and read the message.
5. Select Delete, read the box and select Delete requirement.
6. Try Delete on a requirement that already has submissions.
expected: Save shows "Requirement updated." The box "Mark this requirement inactive?" says organizations will no longer need to submit it; after confirming the message reads "<name> marked inactive." and switching on shows "<name> marked active." with no box. Delete shows "Delete this requirement?" and then "<name> deleted." A requirement with submissions is refused with "This requirement already has submissions. Deactivate it to preserve those records." A requirement of a completed semester cannot be edited ("Completed semester requirements are read only." VERIFY).

title: Review queue filters, count and empty states
preconditions: Signed in as SAO 990001.
steps: 1. Open the Review queue tab and read the count above the table.
2. Open "Filter by status" and try Awaiting review, Approved, Returned and All statuses.
3. Open "Filter by organization" and choose one organization.
4. Choose a combination that has no rows and read the message.
